decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (northern and southern) walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the above, the windows formed in the flank (northern and southern) elevations shall be fixed closed and obscure glazed and shall be so retained permanently.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear conservatory extension to dwellinghouse.
